text.description_html:
Fusion RH-T9, American Relic Series Southern Manor Robe Hook

The Southern Manor Robe Hook is not only great for hanging bathrobes as the name suggests, it is a stylish way to hang just about anything: hats, purses, dishcloths, towels, and even coats. The RH-T9 American Relic Hook is easy to install as it comes packaged with all the necessary hardware so do not hesitate to add them all over the house for their extra organizational abilities.

Also Available Matching: Southern Manor Towel Bar, Southern Manor Towel Ring, and Southern Manor Toilet Tissue Holder

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Southern Manor Robe Hook:

  • Mount Width: 2-3/4"
  • Mount Length: 3-1/2"
  • Mount Projection: 1/2"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
